correctness.rationale: For uniform solid K_d and full affine L² projector (d>=2), the independent Beta(m,1)-height/uniform-ball decomposition gives eta=m/(m+1), var(T)=m/((m+1)^2(m+2)) and transverse covariance m/((m+1)(m+2)); covariance inversion gives equation (1). Integrating its signed apex row gives A_m=2(m+1)((m+1)/(m+2))^m-1. The cap L¹ row is <= its L² reproducing norm B_m=sqrt(1+(m+2)^2/m). Rational m=3,4 and an exponential lower bound for m>=5 show A_m>B_m. Evaluation-point affine interpolation gives |Lambda(x,s)-(1-s)A_m|<=sB_m and strict unique apex; A_m~(2/e)d, B_m=O(sqrt(d)) give the uniform profile and iff height-to-zero near-maximizers. Independent checks verify 99 dimensions and covariance identities; finite checks do not establish the theorem.
